visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with bangs, wearing a ribbed beige long-sleeved outfit, sits on a light wood floor. An adult hand holds a fuzzy brown kiwi in front of her. A large, unpeeled pineapple sits on the floor between her legs. (2) Close-up of the pineapple's rough texture. The girl points at the top of the fruit with her index finger. In the background, another small child wearing a floral mask and a cream sweater sits near a picture book. (3) The girl touches the scales of the pineapple with her small hands. The lighting is bright and indoor-natural. (4) The girl lifts the heavy pineapple, tilting it slightly. The background child continues to look at the floor. The setting is a clean, modern home interior. (5) The girl stands up and looks down at a wooden plate held by the adult, containing two halves of a sliced green kiwi with black seeds. She reaches out with both hands. (6) The girl holds a large kiwi slice and takes a big bite, including the skin. Her expression is focused and eager. (7) Close-up shots of the cut kiwi and then a cut pineapple half on a plate. The girl's face is seen from the side as she continues eating. (8) The adult hands a yellow cube of pineapple to the girl. She takes it with her fingers and puts it in her mouth, chewing with her cheeks full. (9) A pink outro screen appears with a cartoon illustration of a girl holding a fruit and white text at the bottom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar plucking begins. A friendly male adult voice says, 'Zhe ge shi qi yi guo.' A toddler's high-pitched voice is heard babbling in response. (2) The adult warns 'Deng...' as a soft squishy sound occurs. The background BGM remains steady and cheerful. (3) Adult asks a question with rising intonation. The toddler shouts 'Niu!', followed by adult laughter and a gentle correction. (4) The toddler protests in a whining but cute tone, 'Bu yao, bu yao,' with higher vocal intensity. (5) A bubbly pop SFX sounds as the adult reveals the sliced fruit. The toddler excitedly screams 'Qi yi guo!'. (6) Wet crunching and chewing sounds are audible as the toddler eats. The adult speaks in a surprised, humorous tone about her eating the skin. (7) A teaching segment begins with the adult identifying 'Feng li' (pineapple) and colors like 'Huang se' (yellow) and 'Lv se' (green). The child repeats with clear, high-pitched articulation. (8) Final segment features the child asking for more fruit with high arousal. The BGM concludes with a short synthesized jingle over the logo.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: Educational family content showing a toddler learning to identify fruits (kiwi and pineapple) and their colors through interactive play and tasting with an adult.
